item.title: To Catch A Nazi, Don’t Go To The Movies
item.description: Allan Appel reports on a Yale Program for the Study of Antisemitism lecture on what cinema gets all too wrong about immigrant Holocaust perpetrators after World War II. The post To Catch A Nazi, Don’t Go To The Movies appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Teachers Strike Revisited
item.description: The fourth annual Judith Ann Schiff Women’s History Program at the New Haven Museum Sunday highlighted the often-overlooked role Jewish women played in shaping labor activism in the city, including the public school teachers whose 1975 strike reshaped union power and civic life in the Elm City. The post Teachers Strike Revisited appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: New Community Theater Sings Their Hearts Out
item.description: Scanning through a pink-hued program for East Rock community theater troupe Rosetint's second-ever production—a Valentine's Cabaret called Love Notes—I had just one question. How were they going to fit 23 performances in one show? The post New Community Theater Sings Their Hearts Out appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Mandy Sells Sells Sells 16 Buildings In 2 Months
item.description: Mandy Management affiliates have sold 16 buildings containing 52 different apartments for more than $7.6 million so far this year -- as the local megalandlord continues its recent trend of divesting itself of swathes of its extensive New Haven real estate portfolio. The post Mandy Sells Sells Sells 16 Buildings In 2 Months appeared first on New Haven Independent.
